name: LILT
description: Seamlessly integrate high-quality, guaranteed translation capabilities directly into your Claude instance, bringing your brand's unique context where you already work. Submit content for brand-aligned translation via customized AI or human-verified translation with a simple prompt, ensuring the highest quality while you maintain full control.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LILT to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LILT to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.lilt.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LILT MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LILT provides these MCP tools: translate_text, translate_files_with_verification, get_credit_balance_information, check_job_status, and download_job.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LILT?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LILT in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
LILT requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LILT is developed by LILT. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
